text:
```yaml
name: Clang Static Analyzer

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  analyze:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container: ghcr.io/devcontainers/images/cpp:latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Install LLVM and Clang
        uses: KyleMayes/install-llvm-action@v2
        with:
          version: "latest"

      - name: Run Clang Static Analyzer
        run: |
          scan-build make

      - name: Upload scan-build HTML reports as artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: clang-static-analysis-report
          path: ./scan-build-out/
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Log artifact URL
        id: artifact_url
        run: echo "::set-output name=artifact_url::https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}#artifacts"

      - name: Summarize artifact URL
        run: echo "Clang static analysis report can be found [here](${{ steps.artifact_url.outputs.artifact_url }})."
```
